description: First flew 12 March 1965 and is a genuine Southeast Asia combat veteran; restored by a volunteer team led by Kevin Korterud and unveiled on Veterans Day 11 November 2011; a second restoration phase began in spring 2020 repainting it in accurate Federal Standard three-tone Southeast Asia camouflage with high-resolution vinyl markings and deliberately reproduced paint drips; wears the FE tail code
aliases: Phantom II; Phantom; c/n 917; FE; F4; F4C
